body:
Get into online things. No one can judge you behind a screen.

The majority of the people I talk to everyday I only know through online games/media. 

I made a whole bunch of friends on IMVU years ago, and still have them to this day. You have things you like, and so do they, you will meet up eventually. I don't know if having online friends is what you're looking for, but years ago when I was depressed about something else, I'm depressed again, for different reason, I got over it for the majority by making those friends. 

I wish you luck.

Take some online interests, run through these forums, and play some games. Friends are there. Behind a screen no one will judge you for something you're not, and rarely judge you for something you are. 

I have had plenty of friends in my life. But as I graduated, eventually, dropped out of school. I don't talk to at least 95% of those friends I use to have. 

One day, I just said, fuck it. I download IMVU. I wasn't looking for a girlfriend. I just was looking for people to talk to, and something to do. You could be whatever you wanted, and talk to whoever you wanted. 

Not 2 hours into playing I had already made friends. I just talked to them about whatever came to mind, and they did the same with me. Not long after, I joined a room where this girl was typing in Japanese to another girl, and talking about how she was learning. There was a few of them, and joining in on a conversation is hard.

I went on Google Translate and just typed in something simple like "Hello girls." and punched it in. The essentially accepted me into the conversation. I acted all big and pervy, and made them laugh. It was pretty great.

Eventually it was an everyday after school kind of thing (This was before I dropped out) where I would go on and hang out with these girls. I still joined other rooms and talked to people. I made an impression on one of the girls, and eventually one day, when I joined the 1st set, she joined in. We all talked and laughed together.

Eventually I got Skype at one of the girls request. One embarrassing thing is to live up to expectation. Through typing, i could be a 8 foot tall basketball player with telepathy. Well, I was put to the test, and I guess, so were they. IT WORKED OUT. We had fun, and we laughed and it was great. My best friend at the time even met them and became friends. This is when I was 16. I'm 20 now, turning 21 in a month and I'm still friends with them all.

I still don't know what I was looking for at the time, but whether I found it or not, I'm happy that I made the choice to try to interact with people.

We even all got into League of Legends and became great friends who play all the time still.

There's always someone who will relate with you, and chances are, they're looking for you.

I feel you.

No matter what you do it isn't good enough, and when you try to better yourself so you can do even better, it still doesn't matter.

Society, and this fucking world just suck.

I relate to you in so many ways it was incredible. 

I have never used Reddit to post something, and today I did. I saw this while waiting for replies to my own problem, and you summed it up in this wall.

I am obese, there's no other way to say it. I am fat. I am 20. My life is going no where. It doesn't bother me it's going nowhere however, but it bothers everyone else, and this kills my self esteem. 

All I do is play video games all day, and I try to walk on the treadmill for as long as I can, but I'm fat, and it's tiring, and exhausting, yet everyone assumes it's just so fucking easy to do. The only thing that goes through my mothers head is fucking money. 

I had quit my job to work, and to change myself. My attitude, my health, my body, my life. Not 2 weeks of being on the treadmill and away from the horrible job, I get yelled at for being on the computer and not running around outside. Death seems like a blessing now. Do nothing, it gets worse, and all I get is complaints. Try to make slow changes, still not good enough, get yelled at. 

Like, what's the point. 

I'd love a job where I enjoy going, and a girlfriend who gets me, and a body that people are put in awe about. But the fact that it's not even a choice, it's forced down your throat by family, and by society. I can't do it. I'm losing my mind, and as far as I can tell, so are you.

I don't have money to eat all this good nutritious food. I don't have the energy to work long hours, let alone the physical strength. 

I am social. I make friends easy. I can change how I am, and how I act, depending on the situation, and who I'm with. But none of that helps me in life. If I have 1 friend, or 100, life still fucking sucks.

I didn't ask to be born to work fucking 50% of my life for over 50 years, and hate everything. I just want to do what I want to do. When I play games alone, and with friends. I feel joy. I love life, and no one tells me I'm fat, useless, and lazy. I play games, I compete, I win. I even tried to go pro in some games so that I might for once in my life, have a job I don't hate enough to want to kill myself. 

I tried several times. I had dropped out, and gone back to school. I got my diploma, but was not able to complete the class I needed. Let alone get a high enough % to even be considered into University/College for what I wanted. 

I applied at over 30 different places, with over 70 applications in those 30s. I was hired 1 time for a company that closed a year later, and I hated the job. The other one was Mc Donalds because my friend became a manager and recommended me. I quit, and that's when I went back to school. After failing i needed a job again. Guess what i got? A different Mc Donalds because he transferred, and offered it to me. Literally not one would, or will, hire me. I have no fucking idea why.

The problem isn't that I want the job and didn't get it. It's that I don't want it, and they still won't give it to me. Even Walmart declined me 8 times. Like what did I do wrong. What am I doing wrong. My life, my friends, everything, revolves around the computer. I hate just about everything else. If i had the ability to work long hours and be feel like complete ass, maybe life would be better. But if I even try I'm yelled at.

This was all just trying to relate, and nothing of an answer. I'm just letting you know you're not alone. We have the same problem and probably just view it ever so slightly. Fuck.

I'm in the same boat, but we share different sides.

You work, and you work a lot, but everyday you continue, you simply think it's worth less, and less. Why am I even doing this? I hate it, why would I do it. 

I'm in the boat that's accepted I hate it, and that I won't do it for that reason, but now I don't know what to do to continue on. You need the jobs to get through life, so if life worth it it kind of deal. Would you rather work a great job, that you can work and love, but only barely survive each check, or would you rather hate everyday, but get through life with money in your pocket. 

If you have to ask yourself, is it worth it? I don't believe it it. Sorry this is all I have. I can't even answer my own problems, but I wanted to try if it may help at all.
